record.question: By legalising same-sex marriage on May 17, 2019, ________ has became the first Asian country to legalise same-sex marriage.
record.explanation: Answer D: Taiwan. Taiwan’s Legislative Yuan passed its same-sex marriage implementation act in May 2019, making Taiwan the first jurisdiction in Asia to legalize same-sex marriage. The source says “country”; using “jurisdiction” is more precise. Reference: https://english.ey.gov.tw/News3/9E5540D592A5FECD/1f7e8a67-6276-41e3-a18f-00dfe5bcd1a2. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
